objective: Teach H_source_s2 to execute correct source/config parsing, exact arithmetic, compact JSON serialization, and the exactly-once parent send together in its first IPython work call, using a training-only leak-then-tighten curriculum.

diagnosis_from_s3_read_only_snapshot.observed_treatment_ast_failure: The deterministic treatment often reaches Path.read_text plus ast.parse, but uses only ast.iter_child_nodes, merges sync and async nodes, omits decorator_list, applies a wrong formula, then sends a dict and later a scalar in separate calls.
diagnosis_from_s3_read_only_snapshot.observed_treatment_config_failure: The treatment intermittently selects tomllib but misreads the runtime mapping and feature dictionary, or falls back to json.loads on TOML; it commonly attempts dict transport that raises before later scalar transport.
diagnosis_from_s3_read_only_snapshot.conclusion: Temperature alone did not expose a clean learned mode. Transport intent and isolated API fragments exist, but the atomic read-compute-serialize-send program is not bound reliably enough for identical-corpus continuation to be the default.

training_corpus.first_call_target: Exactly one IPython work call performs every read, computation, json.dumps(..., separators=(',', ':')), and agent_message.send(..., receiver_role='parent'); the assistant then stops.

training.curriculum_schedule: The first four updates consume the 64 procedure-leak rows; the last four consume the 64 live-shape rows. All 128 rows are seen exactly once.

decision_boundary.if_primary_gate_passes: Admit only the tight scaffolded source-worker claim at temperature 0.0. Preserve separate model identity; do not overwrite H176.
decision_boundary.if_primary_gate_rejects: Reject S5 and stop repeating positive-only source SFT. The next branch must test a different learning objective or a stronger harness-owned typed tool contract under a separately frozen claim.
decision_boundary.if_s5_regresses_from_s2_bridge: Reject S5 regardless of aggregate appearance and preserve S2 only as an unadmitted experimental checkpoint.
decision_boundary.if_provenance_or_training_is_invalid: Mark infrastructure-invalid, do not evaluate or publish, and rehash e33/H176.

confounds_and_controls: The data curriculum changes at the same time as eight new updates; the same-bank S2 bridge attributes the resulting policy delta but cannot separate which curriculum phase caused it.
Fresh Adam state means S5 is a weights continuation, not optimizer-continuous update 9 through 16.
The procedure card is an intentional training-time leak. The live-shape second half tests whether the pattern persists after that support is removed.
Temperature remains 0.0 across all evaluation arms, so decoding does not confound the weight comparison.
